paperEvidenceEmpty: Save a highlight or image annotation as evidence to start
paperEvidence_user-verified: I checked the source and claim
paperEvidenceCheckDisclaimer: Locator checks do not verify a claim. Semantic support needs your review.
paperEvidencePartial: Text incomplete or not fully checked
paperMatrixEmpty: Choose papers in the library, then create a matrix. Existing matrices reopen here.
paperMatrixNoEvidence: No evidence linked; not a verified result
paperMatrixNoRank: Values are not a leaderboard. Compare datasets, versions, splits and conditions before drawing conclusions.
paperReadingLocal: This request stays local · no AI call
paperReadingDisclosure: Only the listed text is sent to this model. One model request; no tools, downloads, subagents or file changes.
paperReadingNoLocalModel: Local evidence and matrices work without AI. Local-only model inference is not available; no request will be sent.
paperReadingInsufficient: This purpose needs full text. Quick screening can use limited material with an explicit warning.
paperReadingNoMaterial: No readable source material is available
paperReadingLocalControls: Evidence and matrix edits are local. AI reading requires a separate, explicit model request.
paperEvidenceHiddenMarks: Some annotations belong to another or unknown PDF version; inspect them in the annotation list before reusing their page anchors.
paperReadingFiguresUnbound: Figure extraction confidence does not establish a PDF version or semantic correctness.
paperReadingStaleSelection: The selected passage has an unknown or different PDF version. Reload the paper and select it again.
paperReadingFixedModel: Choose a fixed model and provider in the conversation model picker. Automatic routing and external agent SDKs are not supported for bounded reading yet.
